items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Kimball was a man that could play anything, anyway. ... Yeah, he used to play at the Palace.

ctx.x: Real 2, Emil Barnes, okay? January 3rd, 1962. We're talking about, you say Kimball was a reader? Yeah.

But he could play blues too, huh? He could play blues, but Kimball was a man that could play anything, anyway. Could really put you in the alley, huh? Yeah, he used to play at the Palace. Yeah, the one in Mission there. He would play the blues
and run them crazy. What band was that?
